questions.question: In head-to-head T20 meetings, who has the edge, Iinyathi or Kei?
Which South African provincial union has a team playing in the Women's Japan Premier League?
questions.explanation: A result of the partnership between Titans Cricket Union and Japan Cricket Association.

questions.question: Boland set a database record (13/14 season, List A) with a value of 400. Which record is it?
options: Lowest Team Total (all out or completed innings)
questions.explanation: It's the record for 'Highest Team Total', held by Boland.

questions.question: At Bloemfontein Oval, who holds the record for 'Most Matches' (List A)?
questions.explanation: Gezelle Jansen van Rensburg holds it with 18.

questions.question: At which ground did Thabelani Metu record their career-best innings (40, List A)?
questions.explanation: It was at Buffalo Park, against Kei on 2024/03/16.

questions.question: At which ground did Iinyathi record their 'Highest Total' (T20)?
questions.explanation: It was at Kimberley Oval — highest total of 162, against Heat on 2015/10/18.
